title: 歩道用ガードパネル
description: 支柱、縦格子、固定金具、連結タブを備える歩行者用の独立した柵パネル。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A standalone powder-coated pedestrian guard panel with steel pickets, foot plates, anchor bolts and joining tabs. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner's request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
